configuration.title: MatterWave
config.baseUrl.description: The MatterWave deployment this editor talks to.
config.caFile.description: Path to a PEM file holding the certificate authority that signed the deployment's TLS certificate, for a deployment behind a private CA. Trusted in addition to the system's authorities. Empty uses the system's authorities alone.
config.commitMessageStyle.markdownDescri: How **Generate Commit Message** writes a message: a convention (Conventional Commits, a ticket prefix) or plain words. Empty uses a summary line of at most 72 characters in the imperative mood, a blank line, and a short body saying what changed and why. A workspace can set its own.
config.showAnswerUsage.description: Show under each answer the tokens it used and their cost at the model's list price.

walkthrough.gettingStarted.title: Get started with MatterWave
walkthrough.gettingStarted.description: Sign in, ask about your code, and let MatterWave change it under review.
walkthrough.gettingStarted.signIn.title: Sign in
walkthrough.gettingStarted.signIn.descri:
Confirm a code in your browser, or paste an API key. The credential stays in the editor's secret storage.
[Sign In](command:matterwave.signInWithDeviceCode)
walkthrough.gettingStarted.askAboutSelec:
Select some code and ask about it; the answer streams into the chat view.
[Ask about Selection](command:matterwave.askAboutSelection)
walkthrough.gettingStarted.apply.title: Apply an answer's code
walkthrough.gettingStarted.apply.descrip:
Every code block in an answer has Apply. A diff opens first, and the change lands in the editor, where Undo takes it back.
[Open Chat](command:matterwave.openChat)
walkthrough.gettingStarted.inlineEdit.de:
Select lines, say what should change, and review the diff before it lands.
[Edit Selection](command:matterwave.inlineEdit)
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces.descrip: In Restricted Mode MatterWave chats and reads context, but does not change files (Apply, inline edit, Restore Checkpoint) or run git for @git until the workspace is trusted.
